stages.label: Incubated Tenant
stages.description: Tenant lives inside Opsly as a governed pilot with template-only deployment.

stages.label: MVP Validation
stages.description: Tenant is proving the first workflows and operating assumptions.

stages.label: Operational Stabilization
stages.description: Tenant has repeatable workflows, monitoring, and support playbooks.

stages.label: Dedicated VPS
stages.description: Tenant can be provisioned to an isolated VPS with extraction prep in place.

stages.label: Independent Platform
stages.description: Tenant has enough operating maturity to run as its own platform stack.

stages.label: Connected Client Platform
stages.description: Extracted client platform that remains connected to Opsly governance and observability.

deployment_readiness.template_ready: tenant template exists and can be bootstrapped safely
deployment_readiness.workflow_bootstrap_ready: first workflow bundle and approvals are defined
deployment_readiness.vps_ready: dedicated VPS provisioning can be prepared
deployment_readiness.extraction_ready: tenant can be extracted with bounded operator work
deployment_readiness.blocked: an explicit approval or dependency is missing
